items.text: Smart collection sync — inline edit and delete from smart-collection rows update the canonical bookmark on the page and allBookmarks; note and tags stay in sync across columns; delete undo restores the global view too.
Inline delete confirm — delete from the inline editor no longer conflicts with click-outside handlers; the confirm modal stacks above the editor with correct focus.
Discard confirm modal — unsaved inline-edit dismiss uses AppModal instead of a native browser dialog.
Reorder flush — debounced bookmark reorder persists immediately on page switch or tab hide (mirrors category-order flush).
Page rename errors — failed page-tab rename rolls back the local name and shows a localized error toast.
Neutral grid on page switch — keyboard selection clears on page change unless you were already navigating with the keyboard.
G chord — G then 1–9 jumps to a category only; it no longer switches pages or feeds into shortcut search.
Search overlay guards — >, :, ?, +, and & are blocked while page overview, omnibox, inline edit, tag cloud, or other modals are open.
Search ghost overlay — rebuilding shortcuts after a page switch or reorder closes an open search UI instead of leaving a stale overlay.
Page shortcuts vs search — 1–9 and Shift+←/→ no longer change pages while the search overlay is active.
Delete on smart rows — the Delete key resolves the bookmark by URL/reference (same as ;) so it works on smart-collection copies.
Mac shortcuts — Cmd+C copies the selected URL; Cmd+Home / Cmd+End jump to the first/last bookmark on the page.
Swipe & omnibox guards — horizontal swipes and keyboard grid navigation respect isModalOpen() (page overview, omnibox, app modal).
Paste during tag cloud — Ctrl+V quick-add paste is ignored while the tag word cloud is open.
Page overview — desktop close button; focus returns to the trigger; list wraps at the ends; visible page names use locale fallbacks.
Omnibox focus — closing the quick-add omnibox restores keyboard focus to the prior control.
Search input a11y — mobile search field and bookmark grid use data-i18n-aria labels in EN / NL / DE / FR.
Essentials / Advanced / All — three views on config#general with a persisted layer preference (localStorage), per-layer intros, and Show all sections on one page as a third tab with aria-selected.

Panel restructure — Appearance split into essentials vs advanced; everyday bookmark options moved to Bookmarks (essentials); compact Smart collections and Status monitoring summaries in Essentials; full tuning stays under Advanced.
Collapsible sections — every General card can collapse/expand (click or keyboard on the title); state persists per panel; default open sets differ per layer; the Reset card always starts collapsed.
Hash deep links — #general/advanced/layout opens the right layer and scrolls to the panel; sessionStorage restores your General sub-path when you switch away and back from another config tab.
Smart collections summary — Essentials shows an enabled count ({count} of {total}) and a master toggle that mirrors the individual collection checkboxes.
Status essentials — compact on/off summary with monitored bookmark count and a contextual Health → link; refreshes when the header health badge updates.

Section nav — sticky jump links for every Essentials and Advanced panel (including separate Smart (overview) vs Smart (settings)); horizontal scroll on narrow widths; active link highlights while you scroll (IntersectionObserver, tuned for All view).
Expand / collapse all — bulk controls in the All view; respects the always-collapsed Reset card and syncs expand state + reset-button guard.
Jump to Advanced — summary panels link deeper settings with a toast (Switched to Advanced) and automatic layer switch + scroll.

Settings search — results show Tab › Layer › Section subtitles; matching General panels expand before scroll; Help blocks scroll to the right anchor; General tour step for Ctrl+Shift+K / Cmd+Shift+K (desktop only).
Mobile search in General — on phone, settings search moves into the General tab and indexes only language, theme, and layout panels with a device-specific label.
Scroll margins — panel jump targets account for the sticky save bar and section nav (scroll-margin-top / tour scroll padding).

sections.title: Config → General — Resets, ℹ help & polish

items.text: ↺ Reset to default — per-control reset on theme, layout version/preset, sort, columns, density, font preset/weight/size group, background type/opacity/gradient grid/image URL, weather, date/time formats, link-preview delay, status retries, smart-collection limits/keywords/page picks, search flags, bookmark display toggles, and more; tooltip shows previous vs default value.

More ℹ info buttons — short explanations added for packed columns, rotating tips, Hypr mode, fuzzy search, interleave mode, search-flow banner, finders-in-search, sync toasts, page tabs, tag cloud, health dashboard, status retries, bookmark preview maintenance, and related toggles.
Theme editor link — Open theme editor → from Appearance essentials with unsaved General/colour guards before navigating to #colors.
Theme icon styling — favicon harmonization controls mark the form dirty and show a Preview only — click Save hint instead of autosaving immediately.
Language hint — Language changes apply immediately (no Save needed) under the language dropdown; option names follow the current UI language.
Gradient preset names — background gradient chips use localized display names in EN / NL / DE / FR.

Mobile General UX — device-specific intro; layer toolbar, section nav, and bulk bar hidden on phone; named toast when a hidden panel is requested ("{name}" is only available on a wider screen); layout restores on resize.
General tour (11 steps) — adds a desktop Search settings… step before Save; skipped on mobile when the search field is not shown.
Smart collections master — Essentials master toggle syncs child checkboxes, dirty state, and the enabled-count line; updateFromUI re-syncs before save.
Hash & panel open — bare #general keeps your stored layer (not forced to Essentials); nav links, hash routes, and settings-search hits force collapsed panels open.
Reset section guard — destructive Reset all data button stays disabled until the Reset card is expanded.
↺ control sync — custom selects, range sliders, and number inputs refresh their UI after reset; duplicate reset listeners prevented (data-setting-reset-bound).
Form readback — updateFromUI reads font size from the active button, gradient from the active preset chip, and guards invalid column input (NaN).
Checkbox cascades — page-tab names depend on Show page tabs; turning status monitoring off clears Show ping; smart-collection label clicks no longer toggle the parent card.
Defaults & markup — showTips defaults to on; Add-bookmark footer button no longer ships checked in HTML; tag-collections-min-count row has a stable id for show/hide logic.
Accessibility labels — breadcrumb, layer toolbar, advanced nav, columns steppers, and custom title field use data-i18n-aria in EN / NL / DE / FR; collapsible titles expose aria-expanded.

Packaged themes editor — fourth subtab edits built-in palette families (Cherry Graphite, Nordic Frost, etc.); pick a theme, tweak colours, activate under General → Appearance, then Save in the config header.
Export / import — download the active dark, light, custom, or packaged palette as JSON; import merges into the editor (then Save colors to persist).
Undo — per-session undo stack for colour edits; ↑ / ↓ reorders custom themes in the list.
Scoped live preview — preview CSS applies to palette cards only (not the whole page); contrast warning when primary text vs background falls below WCAG-friendly ratios.
Mobile viewer — on phone, the Theme tab is read-only with a banner; editing needs a wider screen (same tab set as other mobile config limits).
Navigation guards — leaving with unsaved colours reloads from disk after confirm; #colors subtab restores from hash + sessionStorage; tab revisit reloads when another tab saved colours.
Custom theme autosave — rename debounces to the server; built-in edits merge on save only (server sanitizeColorTheme); rgba/hex validation and --accent-primary mapping fixed.
Editor shortcuts & search — S saves colours from the editor; settings search indexes colour subtabs and groups; localized preview labels in EN / NL / DE / FR.
ID-based actions — remove, archive, and restore use page id (not list index), so drag-reorder no longer targets the wrong row.
Auto-save reorder — drag or ↑ / ↓ on a focused row debounces ~600 ms, syncs to disk, and shows a localized dashboard-sync toast; dirty state clears after success.
Archive — hide a page from the dashboard and page picker without deleting its bookmarks; restore from Structure or the archived list.
List & a11y — semantic <ul> page list, visually hidden name labels, keyboard reorder, and an intro hint (drag, archive, rename).
Selectors & templates — page dropdowns use visible (non-archived) pages; new-page templates ship localized default category names; mobile blocks page management with a toast.
Tour & search — pages tour uses the shared reorder handler; Escape dismisses without marking complete; settings search finds + Add page and archive.
ID-based actions — remove and merge use category id (not list index) so reorder cannot delete or merge the wrong category.
Auto-save reorder — drag or ↑ / ↓ in config → categories debounces ~600 ms with a localized sync toast (matches pages).
Bookmark counts — each row shows how many bookmarks use the category; merge modal previews how many will move.
Page switch flush — changing the categories page selector saves pending order, names, and icons before loading another page.
Delete flow — impacted bookmarks are counted on the categories page even when the bookmarks tab shows a different page; move / uncategorize / delete choices apply to the correct data.

Validation & polish — duplicate or empty names blocked on persist; icon edits autosave on blur; empty-state hint; mobile guard; settings search indexes add-category and merge; tour a11y + Escape dismiss.
Cross-page data — tag map and drill-down read all bookmark pages; Open loads the correct page via pageId + findByUrl (not URL-only on the current page).
Auto-save — rename, merge, delete, and per-bookmark tag removal debounce ~600 ms with a localized dashboard-sync toast; undo restores all pages and re-persists.
Filter & list — filter narrows cloud and list; clear button and Escape; compact empty-filter hint; full-height scrollable list (bookmarks-style viewport).
Drill-down — page name, category, Open, − tag, show-all for large sets; Search opens Bookmarks with tag: filter.
Rename guard & keyboard — inline rename survives background re-renders; ↑ / ↓ moves focus between tag rows; mobile guard; settings search + tour a11y polish.
DragReorder guard — + Add finder no longer fails when reorder cleanup runs on a null container.
Filter — search finders by name, shortcut, URL, or tags; ✕ and Escape clear.
List & reorder — bookmarks-style rows with drag handle; ↑ / ↓ keyboard reorder; debounced auto-save (~600 ms) with localized sync toast.
Usage stats — per-finder use count and last-used date refresh when the tab opens.
Stable ids — normalizeFinders() assigns unique ids; duplicate shortcuts highlighted inline; save blocked until resolved.
Polish — dedicated CSS; mobile guard; settings search indexes filter and actions; tour a11y.
Finders in ZIP — finders.json always written from the store snapshot on backup.
Import safety — when a ZIP omits finders.json, existing finders are preserved (not deleted as orphans).
Template i18n — intro, section titles, and hints in EN / NL / DE / FR.
Import preview — localized page/bookmark count summary instead of hardcoded English.
Import UX — case-insensitive .zip; window.confirm fallback when AppModal is unavailable.
CSV export — localized column headers, resolved category display names, Tags and Notes columns.
Settings search — backups intro, ZIP/CSV/browser actions indexed.
Help & tips — rotating tips and help text point to config → backups.
Insights — automated highlights (busiest page, top bookmark, never-opened share, status coverage, recent activity) with jump links.
Finders section — finder totals and top-20 table by useCount.
Refresh & Export CSV — reload stats in-tab; multi-section CSV export respects active period filters.
Table filter — one search field filters rows across all stats tables; match count hint.
Row navigation — click (or Enter) a bookmark row to open it in Config → Bookmarks.
Mobile chip-nav — horizontal scroll chips replace the sidebar index on narrow screens.
Honest period labels — opens columns describe lifetime openCount for bookmarks active in the period; sparkline hint clarifies bookmark counts per bucket.
Accessibility — aria-pressed on period buttons; sparkline aria-label + screen-reader table; ℹ buttons get aria-label.
Refresh reliability — IntersectionObserver disconnected on re-render; post-save refresh uses active stats tab (not hash-only).
i18n & data — localized yes/no; Tags tour strings in all locales; period filter on top-tagged; duplicate URL detail list; cleanup score bar resets when empty.
Compact triage layout — nine summary cards on one row (click to filter); search, page filter, status pills, and bulk buttons in one compact panel so bookmarks start higher.
Multi-select & bulk cleanup — row checkboxes, select all visible, bulk favicon refresh, and bulk delete with AppModal confirm.
Open in Config — click a row or press Enter to open the bookmark in Config → Bookmarks.
Favicons & row toolbar — per-row favicon; config-style actions (open, dashboard, re-check status, favicon refresh, overflow heal/delete).
Keyboard navigation — j/k or arrows move focus; Enter opens editor; O opens the URL.
Structured issue reasons — API returns reasonDetails for localized labels; health report includes bookmark icon.
URL state & defaults — filter/sort/search/page sync to the address bar; first visit defaults to broken unless URL or session overrides.
Retest & merge reliability — retest-all sends write token when configured; merge picker no longer silently picks the first group.
Favicon display — row icons load from /data/icons/ like the dashboard.
README & MANUAL — Config → Finders, Backups, Stats, and health beta documented for v2026.06.17.
In-app Help (EN / NL / DE / FR) — What's new recap and Bookmark health help extended under v2026.06.17.
Cache-bust — whats-new-v69 data version; health (health.js, health.css) plus Config Finders, Backups, Stats, Tags, and reorder.js assets updated for Docker-mounted static files.
